question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is '**close**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**close**'. • The term **“close friend”** can be understood as somebody who you can talk to about everything, who makes you feel comfortable without the fear of judgement. • A **“close friend” **can also be someone who is always there for you, who cares about your well-being. • The given sentence is trying to express the fact that Namita had the contact number of a friend whom she could ask for help as she was her very good friend. (दिया गया वाक्य इस तथ्य को व्यक्त करने का प्रयास कर रहा है कि नमिता के पास एक मित्र का संपर्क नंबर था जिससे वह मदद मांग सकती थी क्योंकि वह उसकी बहुत अच्छी दोस्त थी) • Hence, in the given context '**close**' is the correct answer. Correct Paragraph:__ *Namita did not have enough cash. She did not __have__ a credit card either. She found herself in a __fix__. She had the contact number of a __**close**__ friend whom she called for help. Her friend came (4) ______ and settled the bill. Namita thanked her and expressed her (5) _______ . She promised to return the money to her friend soon.* 49:Tcef, The correct answer is '**immediately**'.
